entries.value: Assistant has web search capabilities to find current and up-to-date information on the internet
Can search using specific queries, retrieve multiple sources, analyze and synthesize information
Can search for current news, research, product info, technical docs, historical facts, company details, weather, and statistical data
Users can ask to search for specific information using natural language requests
Cannot access paywalled content, subscription-based websites, real-time data streams, or very recently indexed information
